correctness.rationale: The geometric H-fixed point locus has an exact orbit-barycenter triangulation: an orbit-union is a face exactly when some source part is occupied at most once. The exact k-subcomplex cover U_i=D(F_i)*Delta(all other orbits) has contractible nonempty proper intersections and total intersection T=*D(F_i). When T is empty, the proper-intersection nerve is the boundary of a (k-1)-simplex, S^(k-2); when T is nonempty its (k-1)-fold suspension gives the stated wedge, and a factor f_i=1 cones it off. This checks all k>=2, all n_i>=2, all part-preserving subgroups, including k=2, r=0, f_i=1. The verified source script enumerates 233 finite cases; those mod-two diagnostics corroborate but do not establish the general integral homotopy equivalence.
